notes: Sources: Lake Shore CRX-4K specifications page (cache research/v5/cache/7e6f49fba2afae4a.txt) and Lake Shore Probe Stations catalog PDF probestationcatalog_l.pdf pp. 42-43 (cache research/v5/cache/75efd8eb8da79422.txt), whose cross-section diagram labels 'Radiation shield stage (35 K) / Sample stage (4.5 K) / Probe (15 K) / Probe arm base / Probe arm shield / Thermal anchors / Vacuum chamber base'. Scene geometry: a 280 mm OD x 140 mm tall nickel-plated aluminium vacuum chamber (229 mm top opening, 63.5 mm fused-quartz top viewport with 54.0 mm viewing area, NW40 pump port with isolation valve, NW25 gauge port, 0.25 in NPT gas port, 3.5 kPa relief valve) on an 800 x 670 mm platform; inside, a radiation shield with 132 mm lid and 50 mm IR-absorbing window surrounds the 4.5 K sample stage carrying a 31.8 mm grounded sample holder; two probe arms (this configuration; up to 6 with MMS-09 micromanipulators per catalog p.50) enter from the sides, arm anchored to the 35 K shield, probe anchored to the sample stage. Base temperature 4.5 K applies to 2 arms installed (5.5 K with 4, 6.0 K with 6). Cooldown 2 h, warmup 1.5 h, cycle 4 h, vibration at sample <1 um, base pressure <1e-5 Torr. Ring magnet kit (PS-RING-MAG-KIT) and PS-HTSTAGE (20-675 K) are options, not installed. Cryogen enum: the CCR runs from a 3-phase 6.6-7.8 kW water-cooled compressor, consistent with a GM cooler, but the datasheet never names the cooler type - treat cryogen_free_gm as unconfirmed.
